items.text: Fireworks said GLM-5.3 improved 50% over GLM-5.2 on its coding benchmark and became available on the platform at launch.
items.text_zh: Fireworks 表示，GLM-5.3 在其代码基准测试中较 GLM-5.2 提升 50%，并于发布首日上线平台。

items.text: Replit introduced Growth Kit, a collection of agent skills for cold-email outreach and other tasks involved in turning completed products into businesses.
items.text_zh: Replit 推出 Growth Kit，其中包含冷邮件拓客等智能体技能，帮助用户把已经完成的产品进一步发展为业务。

items.text: Streamlit 1.62 added client-side text-input validation, new input types, layout wrapping controls and public keyboard-shortcut APIs.
items.text_zh: Streamlit 1.62 新增文本输入的客户端验证与输入类型、布局换行控制，以及公开的键盘快捷键接口。

items.text: MiniMax highlighted Fast H3 v1, an accelerated video-generation implementation developed by Hao AI Lab, NuvaLab and Nvidia’s FastGen teams.
items.text_zh: MiniMax 介绍了由 Hao AI Lab、NuvaLab 与英伟达 FastGen 团队开发的视频生成加速方案 Fast H3 v1。

items.text: Perplexity Search’s three context-size configurations took the leading positions on Artificial Analysis’s newly updated Search Index.
items.text_zh: Perplexity Search 的三种上下文规模配置包揽了 Artificial Analysis 最新搜索能力榜单的领先位置。

items.text: AWS released an agent toolkit that lets coding agents configure infrastructure, including CloudFormation resources, after a one-command setup.
items.text_zh: AWS 发布智能体工具包，完成一条命令的初始化后，编码智能体即可配置包括 CloudFormation 资源在内的云基础设施。

items.text: Unsloth compressed GLM-5.3 from 1.51 terabytes to 239 gigabytes at two-bit precision, enabling local operation on 256-gigabyte memory systems.
items.text_zh: Unsloth 将 GLM-5.3 以二比特精度从 1.51TB 压缩至 239GB，使其可在拥有 256GB 内存的设备上本地运行。

items.text: Vercel open-sourced vgpu, a TypeScript WebGPU library supporting browser, headless Node.js and deterministic test environments with a shared shader implementation.
items.text_zh: Vercel 开源 TypeScript WebGPU 库 vgpu，同一套着色器代码可运行于浏览器、无界面 Node.js 和确定性测试环境。

items.text: GitHub added a Copilot customization hub that brings MCP servers, plugins, skills and canvases together under one tab.
items.text_zh: GitHub 为 Copilot 新增统一定制中心，在一个标签页中集中管理 MCP 服务器、插件、技能与画布。

items.text: GitHub added a Sessions sidebar to Copilot CLI for opening, switching between and managing multiple concurrent agent sessions.
items.text_zh: GitHub 在 Copilot CLI 中新增“会话”侧边栏，用于打开、切换和管理多个并行智能体会话。

items.text: Nvidia Warp reached 10 million downloads, marking growing adoption of its Python framework for GPU-accelerated simulation, physics and robotics workloads.
items.text_zh: 英伟达 Warp 下载量突破一千万，显示其面向 GPU 加速仿真、物理计算和机器人任务的 Python 框架正获得更广泛采用。

items.text: Vercel introduced Ora, which runs agents against live websites and traces each action to diagnose failed signups, integrations and payments.
items.text_zh: Vercel 推出 Ora，可让智能体在真实网站上执行任务并追踪每一步操作，以诊断注册、集成和支付流程中的故障。

items.text: Luma released an improved upscaling system intended to produce clearer, higher-resolution results from generated images and video.
items.text_zh: Luma 上线改进版放大系统，旨在为生成图像与视频提供更清晰、更高分辨率的输出。

items.text: A federal judge ruled the Pentagon’s designation barring Anthropic from government supply chains unlawful, delivering the company its first victory in the dispute.
items.text_zh: 美国联邦法官裁定五角大楼将 Anthropic 排除出政府供应链的认定违法，使 Anthropic 在这场争议中取得首次胜利。

items.text: LAION released BVD, an open research dataset spanning 80 million videos and 10 million hours of multimodal footage.
items.text_zh: LAION 发布开放研究数据集 BVD，涵盖 8000 万段视频、共计 1000 万小时的多模态素材。

items.text: US immigration authorities plan to spend $2 million procuring robotic dogs for enforcement operations.
items.text_zh: 美国移民执法部门计划斥资 200 万美元采购机器狗，用于执法行动。

items.text: A Canadian creator’s promotion of Claude drew extensive criticism, illustrating growing social resistance to publicly endorsing AI tools.
items.text_zh: 一名加拿大创作者推广 Claude 后遭到大量批评，反映公开支持 AI 工具正面临更强的社会抵触。

items.text: Meshy hosted its first Creator Day, bringing 3D creators together for demonstrations, discussion and product feedback.
items.text_zh: Meshy 举办首届创作者日，邀请 3D 创作者参与演示、交流及产品反馈。

items.text: Pika added access to Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash through its API Club.
items.text_zh: Pika 通过其 API Club 接入了 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash。

items.text: Pika compared Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, Seedance 2.5 and Wan 3.0 using identical product-video inputs.
items.text_zh: Pika 使用完全相同的产品视频输入，对比了 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash、Seedance 2.5 和 Wan 3.0。

items.text: Tencent compressed Hy4-preview from 1.5 terabytes to roughly 200 GiB using its calibration-guided MIX-STQ1_0 quantization method.
items.text_zh: 腾讯利用校准引导的 MIX-STQ1_0 量化方法，将 Hy4-preview 从 1.5TB 压缩至约 200GiB。

items.text: Ollama completed the cloud rollout of GLM 5.3 and GLM 5.3 Flash with US and European hosting and zero data retention.
items.text_zh: Ollama 云端已全面上线 GLM 5.3 和 GLM 5.3 Flash，提供美国及欧洲托管与零数据保留。

items.text: Ollama published instructions for configuring Claude Desktop to use GLM 5.3 and GLM 5.3 Flash.
items.text_zh: Ollama 发布配置说明，让 Claude Desktop 可以使用 GLM 5.3 和 GLM 5.3 Flash。

items.text: OpenAI’s WebMCP Challenge entered its final weekend, with projects due September 3 and an official support session planned.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 的 WebMCP 挑战赛进入最后一个周末，项目须于 9 月 3 日前提交，并将举行官方答疑活动。

items.text: Luma announced a maker night featuring senior-creator walkthroughs, a shared prompt exercise and in-person creative support.
items.text_zh: Luma 宣布举办创作者之夜，安排资深创意人员演示、统一提示词创作及现场指导。

items.text: Replicate temporarily halved Wan 3.0 generation prices for the weekend.
items.text_zh: Replicate 在本周末限时将 Wan 3.0 的生成价格降低一半。

items.text: Dreamina launched weekly Discord activities offering product updates, creator networking and a chance to win 25,000 generation credits.
items.text_zh: Dreamina 启动每周 Discord 活动，提供产品更新、创作者交流以及赢取 2.5 万生成积分的机会。

items.text: China’s first vehicle-mounted mobile token factory debuted as an experiment in coordinating AI computing workloads with electricity supply.
items.text_zh: 中国首个车载移动式词元工厂亮相，用于探索 AI 计算任务与电力供应的协同模式。
